title: Apartment 4, Glencourt Dell, Co. Wicklow, A98Y963
seoTitle: Apartment 4, Glencourt Dell, Co. Wicklow, A98Y963
description:
Garrett O Bric Property Advisors are delighted to present this own door apartment situated in one of Brays most desirable settings just off the Killarney Road close to all the amenities and services Bray has to offer. The town centre and bustling Main Street are just minutes walk providing an array of shops, cafes and restaurants. The seaside town of Bray lies less than 20 kilometres south of Dublin City Centre and is home to excellent public transport links with a plethora of Dublin Bus Services providing access to the city and beyond teamed with DART and main line train services making the commute seamless. The town has something to offer all, the sea, town centre shopping and mountain walks virtually on your doorstep. 
This is an extremely attractive home in a superb location and is sure to appeal to a broad range of purchaser from first time buyers to those wishing to trade down without compromise. This property benefits from light infused, fresh and exceptionally well proportioned accommodation with tasteful decor and flooring throughout. Upon entering apartment 4 you are greeted by a welcoming bright hallway leading to an impressive open plan living space that maximises natural light and enhances everyday living with this spacious room providing ample room living and dining room areas perfect for modern day living and entertaining. A fully fitted kitchen features bespoke cabinetry and high quality appliances. Two generous double bedrooms, the primary with ensuite and study plus a full bathroom complete the accommodation. This wonderful home is further enhanced by a sunny south facing balcony, a perfectly proportioned outside space for relaxation and al fresco dining. This is truly a superb apartment with a footprint extending to the same area as many three bed semi detached homes and with a location that is second to none offering peace and tranquillity yet only a stones throw from all amenities. Early viewing of this home is strongly advised to truly appreciate all it has to offer.

Accommodation: 

This wonderful apartment boasts own door access to a welcoming hallway with contemporary decor while laminate timber flooring creates a practical yet stylish statement. 

Open Plan Living Dining and Kitchen 
3.5 x 7.5m 
This super spacious room boasts plenty of room for designated cooking, dining and living room areas, the room is flooded with natural from an almost completely glazed wall with central French doors providing access to a wonderful private terrace with a sunny southerly orientation. The outlook is breathtaking overlooking the landscaped grounds with a wonderful sylvan backdrop creating a serene ambience. This is a truly tranquil space perfect for unwinding after a busy day or entertaining family and friends with plenty of space for a large dining table. 

Kitchen Area 
2.6 x 2.6m 
The kitchen is outstanding having been recently upgraded with an excellent range of Shaker style bespoke cabinets in contemporary grey adding a sense of calm and luxury, the classic style cabinets boasts an extensive use of glass maximising light and providing a great way to showcase glassware, china or decorative items. This kitchen is not only an attractive space but a practical one, ideal for creating culinary delights with high quality appliances including built in oven, ceramic hob with stainless steel extractor fan overhead plus integrated fridge freezer, a larder unit provides excellent storage. This wonderful kitchen is complete with tiled floor in large cream porcelain tiles reflecting the light while being easily maintained. 

Primary Bedroom Suite
5.22 x 4.09m 
Spacious primary suite is bright and airy with attractive laminate timber flooring reflecting the light perfectly. A range of his and hers built in wardrobes provides plenty of storage. Generous L shaped ensuite is home to a wc, wash hand basin and shower cubicle with Triton electric shower. 

Study
2.2 x 1.4m 
Just off the primary bedroom lies a room currently used as a study but could be transformed to provide a sumptuous dressing room. A walk in storage room here provides an abundance of storage. 

Bedroom No 2
3.2 x 3m 
With bright spacious double bedroom boasts a picture window overlooking a tranquil sylvan setting. The room is complete with attractive laminate timber flooring at foot. 

Bathroom
Spacious bathroom with high quality sanitary ware in classic white including wc, wash hand basin and bath with shower over head with glazed screen door. The tasteful decor is complimented by classic tiling. 

Outside: 

This wonderful home is set in landscaped grounds with ample secure parking, a short flight of steps lead to a private garden area in front. Off the main living space there is a super terrace boasting a sunny southerly aspect, the terrace provides ample space for a large dining table creating an outdoor dining room ideal for al fresco dining and entertaining. This peaceful setting is perfect for relaxation with a stunning sylvan outlook.
